paper.title: Comparison of Wind Farm Layout Optimization Results Using a Simple Wake Model and Gradient-Based Optimization to Large Eddy Simulations

target_contributions: continuous differentiable near-wake completion of the 2016 Bastankhah-Porté-Agel model
BP-versus-SOWFA validation of the optimized layout
non_target_baselines: SOWFA is validation evidence, not a comparison algorithm to reimplement

paper_native_problem.baseline_and_repeats: one concentric baseline plus 199 feasible pseudo-random starts

model_contract.wake: paper Eqs. 1-10 modified 2016 Bastankhah-Porté-Agel Gaussian wake
model_contract.superposition: paper Eq. 11 upstream-sorted linear velocity-deficit superposition
model_contract.paper_optimizer: OpenMDAO plus Tapenade exact derivatives plus SNOPT
model_contract.open_replacement: pure C++ fixed-width exact forward AD plus analytic constraint Jacobians plus NLopt SLSQP

public_same_lineage_source.claim_boundary: later same-author-lineage numeric evidence, not an author-2019 source release

missing_information: exact author pseudo-random states and all 199 initial coordinate arrays
author optimized coordinate arrays and per-stage histories
SOWFA case directories, precursor fields, time histories and execution environment

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: NREL5MWCPCT_dict.txt labels columns two and three CP and CT, but its source pickle and conversion script show CT and CP
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: follow the source pickle and conversion script; encode CP then CT in the versioned fixture

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: paper Eq. 21 prints a 2000 m hub-centre radius while the same-lineage driver uses 1936.8 m to retain the rotor inside the 2000 m physical boundary
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use 1936.8 m and declare the physical-edge-aware interpretation
preserve the published numeric array without silent renormalization

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: paper requires feasible 2D random starts while a later generator uses one-dimensional rejection spacing
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: follow the paper and reconstruct deterministic feasible 2D starts

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: paper Eq. 20 does not print generator efficiency while the same-lineage driver uses 0.944
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: retain 0.944; the resulting baseline independently matches paper Table 2

hpc_contract.objective_gradient: all 76 exact derivatives in one fixed-width forward-AD traversal
hpc_contract.inner_parallel_axis: twelve independent wind directions in each objective and gradient call
hpc_contract.thread_lifecycle: one persistent worker team per optimization
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: use the empirically highest-throughput non-oversubscribed mapping across all twenty Waffle CPU cores

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the published equations, problem, exact-gradient premise and optimization lifecycle with same-lineage public numeric evidence and open optimizer replacement; not author SNOPT/Tapenade random-state replay or rerun of unavailable SOWFA cases
